blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon:Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez has been ordered to appear before the Sandiganbayan on September 10 as the anti-graft court hears his plea to remain hospitalized while facing a non-bailable plunder case.
Meanwhile, Vice President Sara Duterte has appointed lawyer Paolo Panelo as her assistant spokesperson, adding a new voice to her communications team amid her ongoing legal and impeachment battles.
And 14 Filipino seafarers who survived an attack on a Saudi Arabia-flagged oil tanker near the Strait of Hormuz are now back in the Philippines. /dp
